notes.title: September-Update-Inhalt von Galan Castle
notes.notes:
Dear friends:

After over a month, the follow-up content for Galan's Battle Song has finally been completed and will be officially released soon.

Let's take a look at the official version.


\[Game Content]
15 unique heroes

30 main story chapters, featuring four distinct terrains

70 pieces of equipment, including 10 legendary weapons

56 Soul Stone skills to customize


\[Update Content]
Two new difficulty levels

Nine new side quest levels

Four new training maps for players to replay

Controller-compatible

Optimized maps, heroes, equipment, talents, and monster skills

notes.title: Galan Castle August Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear friends

It has been some time since the last demo! Firstly, we would like to thank everyone for providing us with various feedback and suggestions. In this update, we have optimized the current experience based on everyone's feedback, hoping to bring you a better gaming experience in the new version.


\[Develop Optimization]
Added mercenary upgrade, mercenary job transfer, mercenary talent advancement, and food function

Mercenary Upgrade: Using combat commands in battle can earn experience points. After upgrading, you can obtain attribute values and talent points

Mercenary Transfer: When mercenaries reach level 10 and level 20, they will be transferred using the Medal of Honor and the Advanced Medal of Honor, respectively.

After transferring jobs, you can unlock more talent points.

Mercenary Talent Advancement: Mercenaries can upgrade their mercenary skills by using the corresponding profession skill book.

Food: Mercenaries can permanently enhance their attributes by using food

Adjusted the equipment system

Equipment can be further enhanced in attributes or effects by embedding runes.


\[Strategy Optimization]
Added functions for relics, soul stones, and consumables

Relics: Learning and upgrading relic effects can affect resource acquisition and impact the battle situation at critical moments.

Soul Stone: Mercenaries can equip and obtain different skill effects, giving them more room and possibilities to play according to the battle situation.

Consumables: Mercenaries can equip and use them in combat. It should be noted that consumables are disposable resources, but using them will not consume their mobility, so be prepared for emergencies.

Battle Optimization

Added difficulty levels and optimized map levels

Difficulty rating: When starting a new journey, players can choose between two different levels of difficulty: normal and difficult.

Optimize map levels: Added scene objects and adjusted the layout of scene levels, allowing players to better utilize them for challenges


\[Other optimizations]
Store function: After the level challenge, the store will be refreshed, and players can purchase and equip the desired items before taking on the challenge


\[Subsequent update plan]
Add side quests: Side quests will provide some interesting level content and more resources to help players pass the main storyline.

Add level tasks: Some level tasks will be set up in the level to increase the challenge and fun of the level.

The final words



Thank you to all players for your patience and support. We also hope that you can actively participate in this public test, provide valuable suggestions, and help us polish the game better.

notes.title: The new product festival trial version has been updated
notes.notes:
Since the game was opened for trial play, players have reported that the gameplay is monotonous and the experience is dull. We racked our brains to think about how to optimize and iterate the game. The following is the most important content of this update. The game is still in the demo trial stage, and there may be many bugs. If you have any suggestions, you can join the group to give us feedback.
[olist]
Mercenaries gain experience based on their actions each round, and they can get additional attribute bonuses in addition to talent points when they upgrade

Added soul stone gameplay, mercenaries can match soul stones to gain additional skills

Added prop system, props can restore blood and add energy, etc. Props can be equipped before battle or stolen from monsters

Added holy swords to relics, and monsters killed with holy swords can obtain the corresponding monster's skill soul stones

Added treasure chests to the levels, which can get extra rewards after opening, and there will be thieves in some scenes
